class.name: NetwPredictFold
class.brief_description: Which input one prediction frame drives, and under what label.
class.description: [method NetwMultiplayer._predict_drive] returns one of these, and a game overriding that seam creates its own through [method of]. Every driven frame is labeled, including one that had no new input, so a frame with nothing newer than the last driven repeats the input it already had rather than inventing one. That is why [method label] is never absent and [method fresh] is what separates the two cases. [codeblock] var fold := NetwPredictFold.of(tick, true, NetwPredict.DriveKind.FRESH) [/codeblock] - [method label] the tick the transition is filed under - [method fresh] true when a newer input drove it - [method kind] a [enum NetwPredict.DriveKind] value

method.name: fresh
method.description: Whether a newer input drove this frame. A frame that is not fresh repeats the input it already had, and the tape gains no entry the input does not justify.

method.name: kind
method.description: How the frame was driven, as a [enum NetwPredict.DriveKind].

method.name: label
method.description: The tick the transition is filed under, which is the input's own tick whenever one has arrived and the pass timing when none has.

method.name: of
method.description: Creates one drive choice. [param kind] is a [enum NetwPredict.DriveKind] and naming no member of it is rejected, because a fold the tape cannot classify would file an entry under a kind no reader can act on.
